title: DCLab Code for macOS: the page in a native WebKit window
request: Continue without stopping: the owner chose a local web app first and a native macOS app after it.
plan: A window around the same page, not a second UI: the engine is already behind a local API
Start the server when none answers; stop only the one the app started
A smoke test that loads the page and checks its token

decisions.decision: AppKit + WebKit built with swiftc, no Xcode project
decisions.why: no DerivedData on a disk with 8 GB free; one file to read

decisions.decision: Find Node through the person's login shell, then known folders
decisions.why: an app opened from Finder has a bare PATH and Node lives under nvm

decisions.decision: Native sheets for confirm, alert and prompt; an Edit menu
decisions.why: a WebKit view shows none of them by itself, and copy and paste need the menu

change: mac/main.swift, mac/build.sh, mac/smoke.sh; npm run mac and mac-smoke.

findings.scenario: the app ran and quit with exit 0 but the SMOKE line never appeared
findings.cause: print() is buffered and the app quit before it flushed
findings.fix: write the line unbuffered to standard output

findings.defect: the server log went to the real folder during a test run
findings.scenario: DCLAB_CODE_HOME pointed at a scratch folder but the log path was fixed to ~/.dclab-code
findings.cause: the log path ignored the folder setting
findings.fix: the log follows DCLAB_CODE_HOME like the server

findings.defect: a GUI app launched from a sandboxed shell quits at once
findings.scenario: running the binary directly exited 0 with no window and no output
findings.cause: the shell has no window server access; open goes through LaunchServices
findings.fix: the smoke test launches with open -W --env --stdout

measurements.name: Mac app smoke test
measurements.gate: the page loads in the window with its title, composer and token, then the app quits and its server stops
measurements.result: SMOKE OK: title DCLab Code, composer present, token of 32 characters; port 4319 free after quit
limits: ad-hoc signed for this Mac only
no interaction tested in the window

outcome: DCLab Code opens as a Mac app that starts its own server when needed and stops only that one.
lessons: Test a GUI app through LaunchServices, not by running its binary from a sandboxed shell
Unbuffered output for any line a test reads just before exit
risks: not notarized: another Mac would block it
the page's notifications do not show inside WebKit
